text: Eleven years after their parents died violently, Kaylie Russell brings [the antique mirror she blames|images|mirrors and glass] back to the family house and surrounds it with surveillance cameras and an anchor rigged to smash it. Her brother Tim, just released from a psychiatric hospital, believes it was all ordinary madness. In flashbacks their father [hangs the mirror in his new office|trigger|bringing something home] and slowly [falls under its spell|threat|being taken over], while in the present the plants wilt, the footage shows the siblings doing things they cannot remember, and [past and present start to bleed together|rules|reality comes apart].
